The effect of 3D-printed Ti

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Save for project animal Exp. validation
Han Wang, Kexin Su, Leizheng Su, Panpan Liang, Ping Ji et al. Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2018-12-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2018.08.049
单位: Stomatological Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China; Chongqing Key Laboratory of Oral Diseases and Biomedical Sciences, Chongqing, China; Chongqing Municipal Key Laboratory of Or
通讯: Ping Ji @ Stomatological Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China; Chongqing Key Laboratory of Oral Diseases and  |  Chao Wang @ Stomatological Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China; Chongqing Key Laboratory of Oral Diseases and
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制备的Ti6Al4V多孔支架的力学性能及骨整合效果，与您的方向直接相关，但缺少疲劳测试和应力屏蔽分析。
边界: The paper lacks fatigue testing and explicit quantification of stress shielding, and does not report surface roughness or as-built morphology.
动机· 评估不同孔结构对3D打印钛合金支架骨整合的影响
方法· 设计四种多孔支架，SLM制造，结合有限元分析、压缩测试及体外细胞和体内动物实验
结果· 四种支架力学性能适配且均能促进骨整合与骨生成
验证· 压缩测试、细胞培养及兔体内植入实验
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of different pore structures in 3D-printed Ti6Al4V scaffolds on osseointegration and osteogenesis.
Method· Four porous scaffolds were designed and fabricated using selective laser melting, characterized by micro-CT, finite element analysis, compression testing, in vitro cell culture with hBMMSCs, and in vivo rabbit model implantation.
Result· All four scaffold types exhibited mechanically adapted properties and supported comparable cell viability, proliferation, mineralization, and new bone ingrowth.
Validation· Compression testing, in vitro cell assays, and in vivo rabbit model.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Peripheral Background only none
Milena Supernak-Marczewska, Agnieszka Ossowska, Paulina Strąkowska, Andrzej Zieliński Advances in Materials Science 2018-12-01 10.1515/adms-2017-0046
单位: Gdańsk University of Technology , Faculty of Ocean Engineering and Ship Technology, Department of Ship Manufacturing Technology, Quality Systems and Materials , Narutowicza 11/12, 80-233 Gdańsk , Pola
通讯: Milena Supernak-Marczewska @ Gdańsk University of Technology , Faculty of Ocean Engineering and Ship Technology, Department of Ship Manufacturing Tec
相关性: 该论文涉及多孔钛合金的LPBF制造和表面改性，但未评估应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
边界: No stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stiffness matching evaluation.
动机· 开发多孔钛合金表面纳米管氧化物层及磷酸钙涂层技术。
方法· SLM制备多孔Ti13Nb13Zr，电化学氧化生成纳米管，再电沉积羟基磷灰石。
结果· 成功制备内径30-100 nm的纳米管层，有利于羟基磷灰石沉积。
验证· 仅SEM观察形貌，无力学或生物学验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a surface modification technology combining nanotubular oxide layers and calcium phosphate coatings on porous titanium alloy for improved implant-biosystem interaction.
Method· Porous Ti13Nb13Zr substrates were fabricated by selective laser melting, then anodized to form nanotubular oxide layers, followed by electrochemically assisted deposition of hydroxyapatite.
Result· Nanotubular oxide layers with internal diameters of 30-100 nm were obtained, facilitating subsequent hydroxyapatite deposition.
Validation· Only SEM observation was performed; no mechanical or biological validation was conducted.

FEM based Methods for Uncertainty Quantification in Electromagnetics

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Skim only numerical_benchmark UQ
K. T. Gladwin Jos, K. J. Vinoy 2018 IEEE Indian Conference on Antennas and Propogation (InCAP) 2018-12-01 10.1109/incap.2018.8770759
单位: Electrical Communication Engineering, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, India
通讯: K. T. Gladwin Jos @ Electrical Communication Engineering, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, India
相关性: 该论文将不确定性量化方法应用于电磁有限元模型，其方法（谱随机有限元、随机配点法）可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的不确定性量化。
边界: This paper applies UQ to electromagnetics, not to biomechanics or implant design; no contact mechanics, stress shielding, or biomedical context.
动机· 电磁系统受几何和材料不确定性影响，需量化其对性能的影响。
方法· 采用Karhunen-Loève展开建模材料不确定性，比较扰动法、侵入/非侵入谱随机有限元及随机配点法。
结果· 谱随机有限元法在计算效率上最优。
验证· 以蒙特卡洛方法为基准验证各随机方法的响应。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Electromagnetic systems are subject to geometric and material uncertainties that affect performance, necessitating uncertainty quantification for robust design.
Method· Material uncertainty is modeled as a Gaussian random process via Karhunen-Loève expansion, and system response is analyzed using perturbation, intrusive/non-intrusive spectral stochastic FEM, and stochastic collocation.
Result· Spectral stochastic FEM is identified as the most computationally efficient among the compared methods.
Validation· Stochastic responses are validated against Monte Carlo simulations.

通讯: Matthew Groves @ University of Warwick, Coventry, UK

边界: This paper does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition function, or any biomechanics/implant design context.
动机· 加速多任务贝叶斯优化中的并行采样

Motivation· To speed up multi-task Bayesian optimization by enabling parallel sampling without combinatorial explosion.
Method· Proposes a simple penalization approach proportional to kernel-based correlation, exploiting independence of samples far apart in task space.
Result· The parallel algorithm achieves near-sequential efficiency (69%-100%) across various problem settings.
Validation· Validated on numerical benchmark problems comparing parallel and sequential optimization performance.

相关性: 该论文将PDE求解视为概率推断问题，为不确定性量化提供了新框架，可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模。
边界: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on probabilistic inference for PDE-constrained inverse problems.
动机· 将PDE求解转化为概率推断以量化不确定性
方法· 将PDE算子作为先验，引入观测数据求解逆问题

Motivation· To address uncertainty quantification in PDE-constrained inverse problems by reformulating the solution as probabilistic inference.
Method· Treats the PDE operator as prior knowledge and incorporates observed data as additional information to infer the joint posterior over displacement, stress, and material parameters.
Result· The maximum-a-posteriori estimate recovers mixed finite element results, and the method generalizes to nonlinear problems and higher-order function spaces.
Validation· Demonstrated on a solid mechanics example with adjoint-free second-order inference.

相关性: 该论文展示了贝叶斯推断框架用于量化模型偏差和参数不确定性，方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理模型不确定性量化。
边界: This paper applies Bayesian inference to an electric motor model, not to biomedical implant FEA or surrogate modeling for biomechanics.
动机· 解决计算模型与真实物理之间的偏差及参数不确定性量化问题。
方法· 采用贝叶斯推断框架，通过MCMC近似后验分布，并引入附加项校正模型偏差。
结果· 框架能较好近似模型偏差和参数，展示了在电机模型中的应用前景。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the challenge of quantifying model discrepancy and parameter uncertainty in computational simulations, especially in industrial contexts.
Method· A Bayesian inference framework is employed, incorporating an additional term to correct for model discrepancy, with Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) used to approximate the posterior distribution.
Result· The framework demonstrates promising approximation of both model discrepancy and parameters when applied to synthetic data from an electric motor model.
Validation· Validation is performed using synthetic measurement data from an electric motor model with an artificially introduced model error.

边界: This paper focuses on aerodynamic data sets and does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification beyond point prediction.

方法· 将样本划分为均匀子集，应用贝叶斯学习策略并行训练

Motivation· To mitigate the computational bottleneck of constructing Kriging surrogate models for large data sets in time-critical engineering tasks.
Method· A Bayesian learning strategy partitions samples into low-discrepancy subsets and trains Kriging models on each subset in parallel.
Result· The computational cost is reduced at least quadratically with respect to the number of partitions, with negligible loss in prediction accuracy.
Validation· The method is validated on an analytical test case and a large aerodynamic data set from DLR-TAU CFD simulations.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether osteocyte aging patterns differ between craniofacial and postcranial bones, which may explain differing regenerative capacities in elderly.
Method· Histological analysis of mandibles and femurs from young and old mice, counting lacunae occupied by osteocytes and assessing osteoid formation via Masson-Goldner staining.
Result· Mandibular bone retained ~86% osteocyte occupancy in old age, while femur showed a marked decrease to ~56%, accompanied by less osteoid formation and reduced BMP-2 expression.
Validation· In vitro histological evaluation in mice with preliminary comparative human cadaver data.

Motivation· To determine whether local injection of zoledronic acid solution improves mechanical stability of uncoated titanium implants.

Motivation· To compare the osseointegration of dental implants placed using osseodensification drilling versus conventional osteotome technique in atrophic mandibular ridges.

相关性: 该论文仅关注全髋关节置换术后老年患者的体重变化，未涉及任何生物力学分析或植入物设计。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical metrics; it is purely a clinical weight-change study with no FEA, contact modeling, or implant mechanics.
动机· 探究老年股骨颈骨折患者全髋置换术后体重变化。
方法· 按BMI分组，用Kaplan-Meier分析BMI下降>5%的时间。
结果· 三组BMI下降>5%的中位生存时间无显著差异。
验证· 临床回顾性分析，无生物力学验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate body weight changes after total hip arthroplasty in elderly patients with femoral neck fracture.
Method· Patients were grouped by BMI and Kaplan-Meier survival analysis was used to estimate time to >5% BMI reduction.
Result· No significant difference in median survival time for BMI reduction among normal weight, overweight, and obese groups.
Validation· Retrospective clinical study without biomechanical validation.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To report a rare case of rapidly progressive osteolysis and a large cystic lesion destroying the iliac inner table after cementless THA.
Method· Imaging (CT and MRI) was used to evaluate the extent of osteolysis and cystic lesion.
Result· The cystic lesion eroded the inner table of the ilium, requiring revision surgery with bone grafting.
Validation· Single case report with imaging findings.
